title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Ram Lakhan
desc: Ram, a righteous cop, and Lakhan, his carefree brother, unite for revenge after discovering their father was murdered by two cunning criminals. Justice, drama, and brotherhood drive their journey.

title: Dabangg 2
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, kills a corrupt politician's brother, sparking revenge. When his wife is attacked, an enraged Chulbul takes on his enemies to protect his family.

title: Race
desc: Ranvir and Rajiv were always close as brothers, but fierce ambition, deep dark secrets, and a dangerous game of love quickly turn them into bitter mortal enemies.

title: Fukrey
desc: Hunny, Choocha, Lali and Zafar chase quick money by teaming up with Bholi. When they lose her cash, the friends scramble to fix the mess before facing her dangerous wrath.

title: Don 2
desc: After ruling the Asian underworld, Don targets Europe's criminal scene. Trapped between the Berlin mafia and relentless law enforcement, he fights to survive betrayal.

title: Gangster
desc: Simran moves to Seoul for a new life, but chaos returns when gangster Daya re-enters her world. Torn between him and Akash, a singer, she faces a heart-wrenching choice.

title: Veere Di Wedding
desc: Kalindi's friends Avni, Sakshi, and Meera reunite for her wedding. Sakshi takes them to Thailand, where they rediscover themselves and confront their personal struggles.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Bol Radha Bol
desc: When Kishan returns to a village to reopen his father's factory, he falls for a local girl. But when he goes back home to share the news, he's shocked to find an impostor living his life.

title: Baat Ban Jaaye
desc: Nisha, a wealthy heiress managing her family business, rejects the idea of marrying a rich man. She falls for Suraj Singh, a wedding singer and dancer, unaware of his hidden motives.

title: Table No. 21
desc: Vivaan and Siya, stuck in a monotonous marriage, enter a game show hoping to revive excitement with a big prize, but the challenge soon turns into a deadly struggle for survival.

title: Jaan Se Pyara
desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman. Later, Jai's mentally challenged brother is abducted in return for a mysterious bag that he knows nothing about.

title: Zinda
desc: After 14 years of captivity, Balajeet Roy is mysteriously freed. Determined to uncover the truth, he embarks on a relentless quest to confront those who betrayed him.

title: Bharat
desc: During the India-Pakistan partition, Bharat is separated from his family and left to care for those who remain. He spends his life trying to uphold the promise he made to his father.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
desc: Pawan, a devotee of Lord Hanuman, finds a girl who is speech-impaired lost in Haryana. He soon learns that she is from Pakistan and sets out to reunite her with her family at great personal cost.

title: 14 Phere
desc: Sanjay and Aditi, from different castes, fall in love and decide to marry. Knowing their parents will oppose, they devise a plan to win their approval and unite their families.
